surface.$description: Default background for cards, panels, dialogs and inputs.

surface-raised.$description: Background for elements above a surface: menus, popovers, toasts. Pair with shadow-md.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed areas inside a surface: table headers, code blocks, wells.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind modal dialogs. Translucent; never use for text.

fg-muted.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, metadata. Still meets AA on surface and bg.

fg-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on bg-accent (primary Button).

border.$description: Dividers and decorative borders. Not enough contrast for input outlines.

border-strong.$description: Outlines of inputs and other controls (meets 3:1 non-text contrast).

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator for every interactive element.

accent.$description: Ledgerly brand color: primary actions, links, selected states.

accent-hover.$description: Hover and pressed state of bg-accent.

accent-subtle.$description: Tinted background for selected rows and highlighted areas.

danger.$description: Destructive actions and error text, e.g. the confirm step of a destructive dialog.

danger-hover.$description: Hover and pressed state of bg-danger.

danger-subtle.$description: Background of error banners and invalid-field messages.

fg-on-danger.$description: Text and icons on bg-danger (destructive Button).

success.$description: Success text and icons: 'Saved', paid invoices.

success-subtle.$description: Background of success banners and toasts.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons: past-due invoices, expiring cards.
